$comment: v2.6 -> v2.7 (RC-60) moved the seven web-address settings of a deployment (base-domain, subdomain, domain-mode, domain-format, issuer, root-component, expose-component-on-bare-domain) from the deployment root to the publish-on-web service config on that deployment. Until v2.7 a file carried them at the root, and $defs/deployment has additionalProperties: false, so the schema of v2.6 re-adds them here. expose-component-on-bare-domain was never declared at all before RC-60 -- the wizard wrote it and the gate rejected it -- so it is declared here too, for the versions that could carry it.
